recognize_zh: 視野中有高核質比、染色質細緻、細胞質少的母細胞，同時混有數個核偏位、細胞質豐富深藍的漿細胞（plasma cells）；母細胞加上反應性漿細胞增多，需結合流式 cCD3/TdT 才能歸為 T-ALL。
features: Intermediate to large blasts with high N:C ratio and round to oval nuclei
Fine, evenly dispersed chromatin with small or inconspicuous nucleoli
Scant agranular cytoplasm; some cells show multiple small clear vacuoles overlying the cell
Several plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, clumped chromatin, and abundant deep basophilic cytoplasm
Background with lysed cells, platelet debris, and a bluish amorphous stromal fragment
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a mixed population of immature mononuclear cells and plasma cells. The blasts are intermediate to large with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, fine chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, and scant agranular cytoplasm, some with small vacuoles; Auer rods are not identified. Several mature-appearing plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, perinuclear clearing, and abundant basophilic cytoplasm are interspersed. The blast lineage cannot be determined on morphology alone; with the immunophenotype (cCD3+, CD5+, TdT+), findings are consistent with T-lymphoblastic leukemia accompanied by polyclonal plasmacytosis.

ddx.vs: Identical blast morphology; separated only by immunophenotype (CD19/CD79a/CD10 positive, cytoplasmic CD3 negative).

ddx.dx: Plasma cell myeloma or plasma cell leukemia
ddx.vs: Neoplastic plasma cells are light-chain restricted and usually CD56+ with an M-band, while here plasma cells are polyclonal and a separate TdT+ blast population is present.
Myeloblasts may show granules or Auer rods and are MPO positive, unlike these MPO-negative, cCD3-positive blasts.
